:::{#def-essential-supremum-norm}
#### Essential supremum norm ($L^\infty$ norm)

Let $(S, \salg, \measure)$ be a [measure space](#def-measure-space).
The **essential supremum norm** (or **$L^\infty$ norm**)
of a [measurable function](#def-measurable-function) $f : S \to \reals$ is:

$$
\norm{f}_\infty \eqdef \inf \cb{ C \ge 0 : \measure(\cb{s \in S : \abs{f(s)} > C}) = 0 }.
$$

:::
